task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/sharkdp/fd/commit/cb3fad48bb2d366080efa421d8499ec968f60a6c

reference_change.title: perf: Avoid unnecessary syscall for ignore-contain

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/sharkdp/fd/pull/1914 (the file type of a directory entry instead of a stat call, when --ignore-contain is given), searching a fixed generated tree of 200,000 files (eval/tasks/workloads/rust/make_tree.py), run on the tree where the change is already in

oracle.source: fd's own test suite (unit and integration tests); the change is in src/walk.rs

evidence.note: after-landed: WorkerState checks the DirEntry's file type before it calls path().join(name).exists() for --ignore-contain, so it no longer stats every entry. The task tree is the merge

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Built with the current stable Rust from rustup and the tree's Cargo.lock; the release binary is run directly, not through cargo run
